text:
The Stanley Cup champions went home to Finland this month, and Sebastian Aho made it his trip. NHL.com wrote that Aho and the other Finns took it all in after the Hurricanes' Global Series sweep in Helsinki, and Daily Faceoff ran "Sebastian Aho is playing his best hockey."

It is hard to argue. He has 32 points (13 goals) in 23 games, 12 on the power play, at 19.8 minutes. Carolina takes 60.7% of the 5v5 shot attempts and expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice.

Context matters, though. The Hurricanes are that good with or without him: their chance share is only 1.3 points better when he plays, and Evolving-Hockey noted last season that his strong teammates flatter his raw numbers. His finishing is running hot too, 13 goals on 10.1 expected and 21% shooting against 14% last season, and Carolina has scored 5.4 more goals than its chances deserved with him on. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him as a setup man (93rd percentile in primary shot assists). Our range for his season is 83 to 110 points.
